requirements.note: Translation + notarization only when the document is not in Korean or English. Admitted expected graduates must submit the legalised graduation certificate by 2027-02-26 (p.11 C).
requirements.evidence: 1) 한국어나 영어로 작성되지 않은 서류: 한글 또는 영문 번역공증서 + 아포스티유 또는 영사 확인받은 서류 제출 2) 한국어나 영어로 작성된 서류: 아포스티유 또는 영사 확인받은 서류 제출

requirements.evidence: * 성적표: 백분위 성적 표기

Must be valid on the submission date.

notes: Page references are the printed page numbers of the Korean section (the PDF is laid out as two-page spreads; KR/JP/CN/EN versions in one file). The Korean text prevails in case of differences.
publication_date is the 작성일 of the OIA board post that carries the PDF.
Application 2026-10-12 09:00 ~ 10-23 18:00; documents 10-12 09:00 ~ 11-06 18:00, arrival basis; interviews 2026-12-07 (expected); results 2026-12-18 17:00 (p.6).
Department of Global Studies (국제학부) is the English track; listed under language group D. Track for the guide recorded as KOREAN because all other units require TOPIK.
Documents not in Korean or English need a Korean or English notarized translation (international.pusan.ac.kr Undergraduate Programs page).
Conditional admits via the PNU Language Education Institute must submit the language certificate by 2027-01-29 18:00.

a.evidence: A. 유효서류: 서류접수 마감일(2026. 11. 6.(금))기준 30일 이내 발급한 서류
